_meta.label: CURATED SEED DATA — REAL SOURCED RECORDS
_meta.note: This file replaces the previous TEMPLATE placeholder data. All records are derived from real Pakistani institutions identified in the Career OS Exa Research Pack (Sep 2026). Verification statuses: VALIDATED = real institution/program confirmed from official source, suitable for student display. NEEDS_REVIEW = institution confirmed real, but specific details (deadlines, amounts) need re-verification before display. Dates: '+N' = N days from seed date. 'null' = do not guess. Records marked is_active=false must never surface in student results. Source URLs point to the official page that was the basis for each record.

opportunities.title: HEC Need-Based Scholarship Programme
opportunities.description: Need-based scholarship for undergraduate students enrolled at HEC-recognised universities. Covers tuition fees and a monthly stipend for financially disadvantaged students demonstrating academic merit. Applications submitted through enrolled university financial aid offices. New cohorts typically open each semester.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING program. Deadline and amounts vary each intake — check HEC portal for current cycle.

opportunities.title: HEC Learning Opportunities Abroad (LOA) Scholarship
opportunities.description: Funded opportunities for Pakistani students and researchers to attend short-term academic programs, conferences, and training abroad. Open to undergraduate, postgraduate, and faculty applicants depending on sub-scheme. Previous cycles have covered countries including Turkey, China, USA, UK, and others.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING program. Specific destination and deadline vary by sub-scheme. Always verify against current HEC announcement.

opportunities.title: HEC Chinese Government Scholarship
opportunities.organization: Higher Education Commission of Pakistan / Government of China
opportunities.description: Fully funded scholarship for undergraduate and postgraduate study in China. Covers tuition fees, accommodation, and a living stipend. Pakistani students apply through HEC's online portal. New cycles typically announced early each calendar year for the following academic year.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING annual program. 2026-27 cycle announced — verify current deadline at HEC portal.

opportunities.title: NIT Future Innovators Scholarship — 2026 Cohort I
opportunities.description: Fully funded undergraduate scholarship plus holistic student development program. Cohort I (2026): 25 scholarships. Components include leadership development, innovation challenges, entrepreneurship mentorship, and community projects. Final 25 scholars were announced September 6, 2026. Applications for the 2026 cohort closed August 10, 2026.
opportunities.notes: 2026 Cohort I CLOSED (Aug 10, 2026). Retain as a RECURRING program source — watch for Cohort II announcement. Set is_active=false as this specific deadline has passed.

opportunities.title: USEFP Fulbright Student Program
opportunities.organization: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP)
opportunities.description: Prestigious fully funded scholarship for Pakistani graduate students to pursue Master's or PhD degrees at US universities. Covers tuition, living expenses, airfare, health insurance, and book allowance. Applications open annually with English proficiency and academic merit requirements.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING annual program. Requires graduate-level enrollment. Check USEFP website for current cycle deadline.

opportunities.title: USEFP Global UGRAD Pakistan Program
opportunities.organization: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP)
opportunities.description: One-semester non-degree exchange program at a US college or university for current undergraduate students. Fully funded including flights, tuition, housing, stipend, and insurance. Open to second and third year undergraduate students enrolled at HEC-recognised universities. Strong preference for students from underserved backgrounds.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING annual program. Open to current undergraduates only.

opportunities.title: UoK PEF Endowment Fund Scholarship
opportunities.organization: University of Karachi — Pakistan Education Foundation
opportunities.description: Need-based scholarship for undergraduate students enrolled at the University of Karachi. Awarded from the Pakistan Education Foundation Endowment Fund. Students apply through the university's student financial aid office. Academic eligibility and financial need are assessed together.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING program at UoK. Check current cycle via UoK Student Affairs. Deadline varies each academic year.

opportunities.title: UoK SFAO Financial Aid — Need-Based and Merit Awards
opportunities.organization: University of Karachi — Student Financial Aid Office (SFAO)
opportunities.description: University of Karachi's Student Financial Aid Office administers multiple scholarship streams including need-based grants, merit awards, and donor-funded bursaries for enrolled UoK students across all faculties.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING program at UoK. Contact SFAO office directly for current cycle.

opportunities.title: QAU Alumni Association Scholarship
opportunities.description: Financial support for meritorious and financially deserving undergraduate students enrolled at Quaid-i-Azam University. Administered through the QAU Alumni Association with applications received from the university's financial aid office.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING program. Deadline and award amounts announced each academic semester through QAU.

opportunities.title: State Bank of Pakistan Summer Internship Programme
opportunities.description: Paid 6-week summer internship programme at Pakistan's central bank. Open to penultimate-year undergraduate and graduate students from HEC-recognised universities. Rotations across SBP departments including monetary policy, banking supervision, research, IT, and operations. Applications typically open in the first quarter of each year.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING annual program. 2026 summer cycle deadline has passed. Watch for 2027 cycle announcement Q1 2027.

opportunities.title: WAPDA Paid Internship Programme
opportunities.description: Paid internship programme for undergraduate students studying engineering, IT, finance, and related disciplines. WAPDA runs internship cycles approximately three times per year (spring, summer, and autumn). Placements at WAPDA offices and hydel power projects across Pakistan including Lahore, Islamabad, and project sites.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING 3x/year. Check WAPDA website or Dawn Jobs for current intake announcement.

opportunities.title: ITA Parwaaz Internship Programme
opportunities.description: 8- to 12-week structured internship programme connecting IT students with ITA member companies. Placements are in Karachi-based software firms and technology companies. Open to students enrolled in CS, Software Engineering, IT, or related programs at HEC-recognised universities.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING program. Intake cycles vary — check ITA Pakistan website and LinkedIn for current announcements.

opportunities.title: NCAI Generative AI Research Internship
opportunities.organization: National Centre for Artificial Intelligence (NCAI), HEC Pakistan
opportunities.description: Research internship at NCAI partner centres focused on generative AI, large language models, and applied AI research. Open to advanced undergraduate and postgraduate students with demonstrated ML/Python skills. Research output includes co-authored papers and presentations.
opportunities.notes: Intake varies by NCAI partner centre. A 2026 A-Level research apprenticeship (age 16-24, 2 weeks, NUST H-12) was separately identified but appears historical. RECURRING program at multiple NCAI centres.

opportunities.title: Motive Pakistan Engineering Internship
opportunities.description: Engineering internship at Motive's Pakistan development centre in Lahore. Motive is a US-based fleet management technology company with a large engineering presence in Pakistan. Internships are project-based in software engineering and data science teams.
opportunities.notes: 2026 summer cycle may be historical — verify current intake on Motive careers page. RECURRING company for internship sourcing.

opportunities.title: Arbisoft Engineering Internship
opportunities.description: Engineering internship at Arbisoft, one of Pakistan's top-ranked software development companies and a recognised employer of engineering graduates. Based in Lahore with structured mentorship and project assignments.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING company for internship cycles. Check current openings on Arbisoft careers page.

opportunities.title: 10Pearls Internship Programme
opportunities.description: Technology internship at 10Pearls, a PSEB-registered digital transformation company with offices in Karachi, Lahore, and internationally. Internships placed across engineering, product, and design teams.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING company for internship sourcing. Karachi and Lahore offices both available. Check current openings.

opportunities.title: Systems Limited Software Engineering Internship
opportunities.description: Software engineering internship at Systems Limited, one of Pakistan's largest listed IT companies. Based in Lahore with a structured 8-12 week programme. Strong conversion pathway to full-time employment.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING annual program. Check Systems Limited careers portal for current intake.

opportunities.title: LUMS National Outreach Programme (NOP) Scholarship
opportunities.description: Fully funded undergraduate scholarship for students from underprivileged backgrounds admitted to LUMS. Covers full tuition, accommodation, and a living stipend. NOP students are selected on the basis of financial need and academic potential. One of Pakistan's most prestigious merit-cum-need scholarships.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING annual program. Applications submitted with LUMS undergraduate admission. Check LUMS financial aid office for current cycle.

opportunities.title: IBA Karachi Financial Aid — Need-Based Grant
opportunities.description: Need-based financial grants for IBA Karachi undergraduate students demonstrating financial hardship. Administered by IBA's financial aid committee. Grants partially or fully cover tuition. Applications opened each semester.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING program. Must be enrolled at IBA Karachi. Contact IBA's Student Financial Services.

opportunities.title: NUST Financial Aid Programme
opportunities.organization: National University of Sciences and Technology
opportunities.description: NUST offers multiple financial support options for enrolled undergraduate students, including need-based fee concessions, merit scholarships, and external donor scholarships administered through the university. Students apply through NUST's financial aid office.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING program. Multiple streams — check NUST financial aid office for current availability.

opportunities.title: HBL Graduate Management Trainee Programme
opportunities.description: Competitive graduate-level training programme at Pakistan's largest bank. Open to recent graduates from accredited universities. Trainees rotate across HBL's business units including retail banking, consumer banking, treasury, and operations.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING annual program. Check HBL careers page for current intake. Graduate (not undergraduate) entry.

opportunities.title: Netsol Technologies Internship
opportunities.description: Software engineering internship at NetSol Technologies, a NASDAQ-listed Pakistani software company specialising in financial services software. Based in Lahore with a structured intern programme.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING company for internship sourcing. Check NetSol careers portal for current openings.

opportunities.title: Habib University Financial Aid
opportunities.description: Habib University offers need-based financial aid to undergraduate students. Aid can range from partial fee waiver to full scholarship depending on demonstrated financial need and available funds. Approximately 60% of Habib students receive some form of financial support.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING program. Apply during Habib University admissions process.

opportunities.title: PTCL Technology Internship
opportunities.description: Technology and engineering internship at Pakistan's state-owned telco, PTCL. Placements across network operations, IT, and engineering departments. Based in Islamabad headquarters with possible field placements.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING program. Check PTCL careers page or Dawn Jobs for current intake.

opportunities.title: Ignite National Incubation Centre Internship — NIC Karachi
opportunities.description: Internship and mentoring opportunities within the NIC Karachi startup ecosystem. Interns work alongside early-stage startups in the national incubation programme receiving mentorship, cloud credits, and investor exposure. Placement is with resident startups rather than directly with NIC.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING ecosystem — intern opportunities vary by cohort startups. Check NIC Karachi directly.

opportunities.title: Jazz Digital Summer Internship
opportunities.description: Summer internship at Jazz, Pakistan's largest mobile operator. Open to penultimate-year undergraduates. Placements in technology, digital product, network, and commercial teams at Jazz's Islamabad headquarters.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING annual program. Check Jazz careers portal for current opening. Summer cycle typically March–May application window.

opportunities.title: Telenor Pakistan Graduate Trainee / Internship
opportunities.description: Graduate trainee and summer internship opportunities at Telenor Pakistan's Islamabad headquarters. Structured programme covering commercial, technology, and operations functions with mentorship from senior managers.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING annual program. Check Telenor Pakistan careers page for current intake.

opportunities.title: PEEF Punjab Educational Endowment Fund Scholarship
opportunities.description: Need-based scholarship for Punjab domicile-holders enrolled in undergraduate programs at recognised institutions. PEEF scholarships cover tuition fees and a stipend. Students apply through their enrolled institution. High-achieving students from financially disadvantaged families are the primary beneficiary group.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING annual program. Punjab domicile required. Apply through enrolled university. Check PEEF portal for current cycle.

opportunities.title: Sindh HEC Merit Scholarship
opportunities.description: Merit-based scholarship for Sindh domicile-holders enrolled at Sindh HEC-recognised universities. Awarded based on intermediate and undergraduate academic performance. Applications submitted through enrolled university.
opportunities.notes: RECURRING program. Sindh domicile required. Verify current cycle at Sindh HEC website.

opportunities.title: Pakistan Software Export Board (PSEB) Internship
opportunities.description: Short-term internship at PSEB, Pakistan's IT export promotion body. Interns gain exposure to IT export policy, B2B trade facilitation, and digital economy development. Placements in Islamabad office.
opportunities.notes: 2026 PSEB internship was surfaced as a secondary research lead — confirm official announcement at PSEB website before presenting as active. Mark NEEDS_REVIEW.

opportunities.title: Legacy Inactive Internship (Visibility Gate Test)
opportunities.description: Deliberately inactive record — expired deadline and is_active=false. Must never appear in student-facing results. Used to validate visibility gate.
